subject: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@arborahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. As discussed, you expect a steady ramp in inference usage over the next 3 months and want options that: 1) add the additional committed capacity (top-up) now, 2) align the contract to your annual renewals (co-term), and 3) keep billing/proration straightforward for your finance team.

Can you confirm the approximate monthly token volume increase (tokens/month) and whether you want the uplift to be a permanent increase to the committed capacity or a temporary burst for Q1? That will help us pick the right pricing path.

Also looping in Ben (sales ops) and Lauren (renewals lead) to propose structured scenarios and timing.

Next steps I propose:
- Samir: confirm expected uplift (tokens/month) and PO timeline
- Ben/Team: propose 2–3 pricing scenarios (instant top-up + pro-rata invoice / staged top-up with voucher credit / permanent uplift with small discount)
- Ava: help align on co-term date and approve final option

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message

From: Samir Desai <samir@arborahealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing

Hi Ava —

Thanks — quick answers below:
- We expect an incremental ~1.2B tokens/month starting Jan 1, 2027 as we roll out a new feature to 30% of users.
- This should be a permanent increase to committed capacity (not a temporary burst).
- Procurement timeline: we need pricing and formal invoice by Nov 24 so we can issue a PO the week of Nov 29; target effective date for new capacity = Jan 1, 2027.

On the co-term: our current contract runs through Mar 31, 2027 — we'd prefer to co-term to that date rather than extend to a new 12-month anniversary. If co-terming creates a prorated invoice, that's fine as long as it's documented.

I can loop procurement once you have a clear pricing doc and invoice.

Thanks —
Samir
Head of Product
Arbora Health

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing

Folks — forwarding Samir's numbers (1.2B tokens/mo, permanent uplift, procurement wants invoice by 11/24, co-term to 2027-03-31).

Ben — can you put together: 3 clean options we can present to procurement by EOD 11/23:
A) Immediate permanent top-up (adds 1.2B tokens/mo) — pro-rated invoice for Jan 1 start + 10% uplift discount on the new capacity for annual commit
B) Permanent top-up with co-term adjustment to 3/31/2027 — prorate both old/new buckets into the remaining term and offer a 7% blended discount
C) Staged annualization: partial top-up now (600M tokens) + voucher for the remainder to be applied in Jan 2027; include a small implementation credit and 5% discount on the voucher portion

Please include: unit economics (per-token equivalent), sample invoice amounts with pro-rata math, and a one-page justification I can send to Samir/procurement. Attach as an XLSX and PDF.

Lauren — if we go with co-term B, what internal approvals do we need (legal/finance)? Give me a checklist I can attach.

Thanks —
Ava

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing

Ava / Lauren —

Attached are three scenario worksheets and a short summary PDF. High-level highlights below:

Scenario A (Immediate permanent top-up)
- Add 1.2B tokens/month to existing commit
- List price equivalent: $0.0009/token on new capacity
- Proposal: 10% discount on new capacity => $0.00081/token
- Jan 1 effective; pro-rata invoice for Jan covering new capacity starting 1/1; no change to contract end date
- Estimated incremental monthly cost: $972,000 before discount, $874,800 after 10% discount

Scenario B (Co-term to 3/31/2027)
- Blend existing and new capacity into remaining 4.25 months of term (Dec 1–Mar 31)
- Offer 7% blended discount across blended quantity
- One-time pro-rated invoice covering Dec/Jan pro-rata; then normal billing to co-term
- Short math table in XLSX; sample pro-rata invoice attached as CoTerm_Invoice_ProRata.pdf

Scenario C (Staged: 50% top-up + voucher)
- Immediate 600M tokens/mo added, remainder as a voucher redeemable Jan–Mar 2027
- 5% discount on voucher portion, $25k implementation credit to offset migration ops
- Gives Arbora runway and smaller immediate spend

Attachments: ARB_Deal_Scenarios.xlsx, CoTerm_Invoice_ProRata.pdf

Risks / Notes:
- Deep discounts require revenue ops sign-off; 10% on incremental is within manager approval, beyond that needs director approval.
- Co-term blending requires legal amendment (simple addendum; recommended) — I flagged this with legal for a 48hr turnaround.

If useful, I can convert to a clean single-page summary for procurement; otherwise Ava you should choose the preferred option and I'll prepare the DocuSign.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: ARB_Deal_Scenarios.xlsx (pricing scenarios), CoTerm_Invoice_ProRata.pdf (sample invoice)

From: Arbora Procurement <procurement@arborahealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal expansion: top-up, co-term options and procurement timing

Hi Ava / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed Scenario B and has two asks before we can issue a PO by Nov 29:
1) Please provide an explicit pro-rata invoice line showing the credit applied for the remainder of the existing term (so finance can verify year-end spend). The sample PDF is useful, but we need it as an XLS line item export for our AP system.
2) We need the legal addendum redline (one-page) and confirmation that the effective date for increased capacity will be Jan 1, 2027.

If those items arrive by EOD 11/24 we can route internally and target PO issuance the week of Nov 29. Otherwise the PO will slip to mid-December and push the Jan 1 effective date at risk.

Regards —
Procurement Team
Arbora Health
